known_limitations: Only screenshot-visible player-side rows and visible side/party total rows are normalized; off-screen troop rows are not inferred.
Enemy ordinary troop rows are not transcribed; enemy side and visible party totals are preserved separately from player rows.
The Stoney Sept and Banefort scoreboards are active observations with one defender remaining; no unplayed remainder is estimated.
No active/interrupted battle is combined, subtracted, or reconstructed with a later cleanup or re-engagement.
Cursor/tooltip-obscured numeric cells and white non-numeric upgrade icons remain explicit review items rather than guessed values.
Raw PNG files are not retained in Git; exact hashes, source container provenance, and Library/file citation identifiers are recorded.
Host-vision extraction model/version is not exposed by the host and is recorded as unknown.

evidence: Stark, Northern, Gold Cloak, Riverlands, Westerlands, Crownlands, Rosby, Stoney Sept, Silverhill, and Banefort labels
track_resolution.method: track-specific visible faction, troop, and settlement labels
